title: Optimization of conditional value-at-risk
grounding: Expected-shortfall epigraph and scenario optimization.

title: Risk-averse dynamic programming for Markov decision processes
grounding: Nested conditional risk and dynamic programming, with the correction in R03.

title: Erratum to: Risk-averse dynamic programming for Markov decision processes
grounding: Correction to the original general-state result; finite trees avoid measurable-selection issues.

title: Robust Dynamic Programming
grounding: Rectangular transition ambiguity and robust recursion.

title: Optimal Dynamic Pricing of Inventories with Stochastic Demand over Finite Horizons
grounding: Price-dependent arrivals and the opportunity cost of perishable inventory.

authors: Carmona, R.; Coulon, M.; Schwarz, D.
title: Electricity price modeling and asset valuation: a multi-fuel structural approach
grounding: Structural interaction among output prices, demand and input costs. [Author manuscript](https://arxiv.org/abs/1205.2299).

authors: Callegaro, G.; Campi, L.; Giusto, V.; Vargiolu, T.
title: Utility indifference pricing and hedging for structured contracts in energy markets
grounding: Portfolio-dependent prices and exercise/hedge interactions in incomplete energy markets. Its exponential utility differs from this project’s mean/ES preference.

authors: Brigo, D.; Francischello, M.; Pallavicini, A.
title: Invariance, existence and uniqueness of solutions of nonlinear valuation PDEs and FBSDEs inclusive of credit risk, collateral and funding costs
grounding: Cash-flow-based treatment of collateral, credit, treasury funding and overlapping valuation adjustments.

authors: Brunnermeier, M. K.; Pedersen, L. H.
title: Market Liquidity and Funding Liquidity
grounding: Interaction between funding constraints, margin and market liquidity.

authors: Kleywegt, A. J.; Shapiro, A.; Homem-de-Mello, T.
title: The Sample Average Approximation Method for Stochastic Discrete Optimization
grounding: Repeated sampling and optimization-error assessment. [Institutional record](https://pure.uai.cl/en/publications/the-sample-average-approximation-method-for-stochastic-discrete-o/).

authors: Rawlings, J. B.; Mayne, D. Q.; Diehl, M. M.
title: Model Predictive Control: Theory, Computation, and Design
publication: Second edition, sixth printing; Nob Hill Publishing, author resource page
grounding: Receding-horizon control and the distinction between a local controller and a full value function.

title: MLPerf Inference: Datacenter
publication: Benchmark specification and results portal; accessed 18 September 2026
grounding: Workload-specific quality, latency and throughput conventions for useful-work normalization.

title: scipy.optimize.milp
grounding: MILP status, dual bound, node count and relative-gap fields reported by SciPy.

title: scipy.optimize.linprog, method highs
grounding: LP tolerances, residuals and marginals used for numerical certificates.

authors: Heath, D.; Jarrow, R.; Morton, A.
title: Bond Pricing and the Term Structure of Interest Rates: A New Methodology for Contingent Claims Valuation
grounding: The forward curve as the primary stochastic object and drift consistency. Commodity futures martingale restrictions determine the drift in this model.

title: Representation of Infinite-Dimensional Forward Price Models in Commodity Markets
publication: Communications in Mathematics and Statistics, 2, 47–106; doi:10.1007/s40304-014-0030-1
grounding: Function-valued commodity curves, Lévy drivers, OU realizations and delivery-period operators.

authors: Benth, F. E.; Piccirilli, M.; Vargiolu, T.
title: Mean-reverting additive energy forward curves in a Heath–Jarrow–Morton framework
grounding: Shared additive multicommodity factors and the distinction between real-world dynamics and martingale pricing dynamics. The linked manuscript has the shorter title Additive energy forward curves in a Heath–Jarrow–Morton framework.

title: Stochastic modeling of financial electricity contracts
grounding: Actual delivery periods and consistent aggregation of financial electricity contracts; transferred here to compute service strips.

authors: Duffie, D.; Pan, J.; Singleton, K.
title: Transform Analysis and Asset Pricing for Affine Jump-Diffusions
grounding: Affine transform methods. The project specializes to constant-coefficient OU factors with compound-Poisson Gaussian marks and implements its transforms directly.

title: Hedging of Contingent Claims under Incomplete Information
publication: In Davis and Elliott (eds.), Applied Stochastic Analysis, Stochastics Monographs 5, 389–414
grounding: Orthogonal residual risk and incomplete-market hedging. The project’s covariance-weighted factor projection is a local diagnostic, distinct from a full dynamic martingale decomposition.

title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
grounding: State-space filtering and covariance recursion. Nonlinear observation linearization and jump moment matching are explicit implementation choices.

authors: Longstaff, F. A.; Schwartz, E. S.
title: Valuing American Options by Simulation: A Simple Least-Squares Approach
grounding: Regression-based continuation for exercise decisions. The project adds a finite remaining-rights state and evaluates the frozen exercise rule on independent paths.

title: Derivatives pricing in energy markets: an infinite-dimensional approach
publication: SIAM Journal on Financial Mathematics, 6(1), 825–869; doi:10.1137/15100268X
grounding: Options and Greeks as functionals of an entire forward curve, and cross-commodity covariance.

authors: Aïd, R.; Campi, L.; Langrené, N.; Pham, H.
title: A Probabilistic Numerical Method for Optimal Multiple Switching Problems in High Dimension
publication: SIAM Journal on Financial Mathematics, 5(1), 191–231; doi:10.1137/120897298
grounding: Regression-based switching control. The linked author manuscript is titled A probabilistic numerical method for optimal multiple switching problem and application to investments in electricity generation. The project uses a finite operating grid, independent policy evaluation and a perfect-information comparison.

title: Approximation of forward curve models in commodity markets with arbitrage-free finite dimensional models
grounding: Separates a curve-valued architecture from its finite-dimensional realization. The project uses an exponential loading family exactly closed under delivery-date transport.

title: The Empirical Characteristic Function and Its Applications
grounding: Empirical characteristic-function estimation. The conditional OU–Lévy moment weights, identification diagnostics and path-cluster bootstrap are specified explicitly in the project.
